text:
tasha: hi all — accepted the org invite but my profile shows "Pending" and i can't open any private repos (403). 2FA is set up with a YubiKey. any ideas?

[devex-bot]: GitHub Invite Event 1978881111: invitation accepted for tasha. Note: SAML SSO & account email mapping can block repo access.

rachel: welcome! quick checks: 1) does your GitHub account email match the invite/work email (Settings -> Emails)? 2) did you click Authorize SSO at https://github.com/organizations/redwood-inference/sso ?

tasha: i verified my work email and authorized SSO but still Pending. i also have a personal GH account with the same username (different email).

pablo: that often causes a duplicate-account mapping issue. run this to see your org membership from the API: ```gh api /user/memberships/orgs/redwood-inference -q .state``` if it returns "pending" we need to reconcile.

rachel: if the account you used for the invite isn't the same as the one you logged into GH with, we can either resend the invite to your active handle or ask people-ops to merge/claim. post the handle you actually signed in with.

tasha: handle is tasha-hacks (the invite went to tasha.work@company.com).

peopleops-bot: Created ticket PO-4521 to reconcile duplicate accounts + ensure SSO mapping. Assigned to peopleops.

pablo: sending a manual conversion now — changing tasha-hacks from outside collaborator -> member and adding to team dev-platform. Give it 2-5 minutes.

tasha: refreshed and can see private repos now, cloning works. thank you!!

rachel: cool — welcome aboard. we'll add a note to the onboarding doc to watch for duplicate personal accounts during invites.
